0022600158.text: The Cavaliers host the Thunder in Cleveland's seventh game of the season, with both teams at 4-2. Cleveland is 3-0 at home, sits 2nd in the Central 1 game back and 4th in the East, and has won its last game, while Oklahoma City is 1-2 on the road, has lost its last two, and sits 2nd in the Northwest 0.5 games back and 6th in the West. Cleveland is without Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and has Peyton Watson day-to-day with hamstring soreness, while Oklahoma City is missing Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Cavaliers lost both games against Oklahoma City in 2025-26, most recently 121-113 in Oklahoma City on February 22, 2026.
